Mossy Forest Object

Source: R/mf_object.R
mossy_forest.Rd

Output for the mossy_forest return type.

Usage

mossy_forest(
  final_rf,
  final_X,
  module_membership,
  WGCNA_object = NULL,
  survivor_list,
  selection_list,
  final_shap,
  shap_obj,
  runtime,
  feature_list = NULL,
  stability_freq = NULL,
  stability_data = NULL
)

Arguments

final_rf

Final ranger object fitted on the stable feature set.

final_X

Data frame of features in the stable set.

module_membership

Data frame mapping each feature to its module.

WGCNA_object

WGCNA output object, or NULL.

survivor_list

Per module screening survivors.

selection_list

Feature lists at each selection iteration.

final_shap

Data frame of stable features with mean absolute SHAP, 95 percent CIs, and shadow stability frequencies.

shap_obj

List with elements shapley_values (signed SHAP matrix, samples x stable features) and interaction_matrix (mean absolute TreeSHAP interaction matrix, stable features x stable features). NULL when unavailable. For binary classification, signed values (and final_shap's direction / dir_corr / signed_importance) describe the probability of levels(y)[1], the first level of the outcome factor. Relevel y if you want a different reference class.

runtime

Named list of runtimes (seconds): Screen, Selection, Final_RF.

feature_list

Data frame of the stable feature set with importance scores.

stability_freq

Named numeric vector. Shadow subsample selection frequency per stable feature.

stability_data

Data frame with per pool shadow stability curves used by plot_stability_elbow. Columns are pool, rank, feature, freq, selected, threshold, elbow_rank. NULL if unavailable.

Value

An object of class mossy_forest.
